create_redis_semantic_cache: create a RedisSemanticCache instance with host, port, password, and similarity threshold
build_set_cache: build a semantic cache entry by storing an LLM response with messages and optional TTL
test_get_cache: test retrieving a cached response by semantic similarity of input messages
refactor_async_set_cache: refactor async_set_cache to store LLM responses asynchronously with custom embeddings
summarize_async_get_cache: summarize async_get_cache to retrieve semantically similar cached responses asynchronously
